notes: Hebrew fascia inscription on the entrance canopy is not reproduced (plain dark strip). South and east faces are inferred (no clear street photo; they abut neighbouring blocks and trees). The wrought-iron entrance gate and low brick garden walls are not modelled. Backlog address 'Van Ostadestraat' is wrong: the synagogue is on Jacob Obrechtplein / Heinzestraat.
